title: parse_duration silently merges digits separated by whitespace into one number
property: a number that is not followed by a unit (e.g. '1' in '1 30m') is rejected, rather than being concatenated with the next number
expected: Err (time unit needed / number without unit), as for '10 months 1'
evidence: Docs: a duration is a concatenation of time spans, each 'an integer number and a suffix'; a number omitted/unit missing is meant to be an error (UnknownUnit with empty unit, test_nice_error_message). The digit loop in Parser::parse treats whitespace as ignorable inside the number, so '1 30m' mis-parses as 130m instead of reporting a missing unit.
